blocks.text: The accusative case is used to denote the direct object of the preceding verb and answers the questions **кого?** — whom? (to see, to know, to remember, etc.) or **что?** — what? (to see, to read, etc.):

head: Nominative
Accusative
Ending
rows: Я вижу девушку. Я вижу деревню.
Я знаю майора. Я вижу учителя.
Я вижу журнал, тетрадь и перо.

blocks.text: Some feminine nouns with stressed endings in the nominative case have the stress on the 1st syllable in the accusative: **доска** — **до́ску**, **стена** — **сте́ну**, **рука** — **ру́ку**, **гора** — **го́ру**, **река** — **ре́ку**. However, the stress stays on the ending in **жена** — **жену́** and **сестра** — **сестру́**.
In Russian, the object of listening is a direct object in the accusative case:

items: We are listening to the lecture.
We are listening to the teacher.

blocks.text: Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: Выпьем за нашу очаровательную ___ (хозяйка, acc. sg.)!
exercises.prompt: Let's drink to our charming hostess!
exercises.why: **хозяйка → хозяйку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like сестра (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я выкладываю ___ (бабочка, acc. sg.) из страз.
exercises.prompt: I'm forming a butterfly from rhinestones.
exercises.why: **бабочка → бабочку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like сестра (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Блаженны чистые сердцем, ибо они ___ (Бог, acc. sg.) узрят.
exercises.prompt: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
exercises.why: **Бог → Бога** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate. Declines like студент (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
